title: Arena viewer v0
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The arena viewer runs the engine live in the browser via WebAssembly: pick a seed and a Chaser/Wanderer pairing, pause, play at 1x/2x/4x, restart, and see the winner. Chaser vs Wanderer reproduces engine-cli with the same seed exactly. The wasm and its JS glue are committed, so GitHub Pages serves them with no build step.
next: Tank Arena rules and agents once the spec clears Nye's gate.
